charts.title: Sales from the manufacture of sports goods in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2010 to 2022 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Sports goods manufacturers' sales in the United Kingdom (UK) 2010-2022
charts.description: This statistic shows the total sales value of sports goods manufactured in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2010 to 2022. In 2022, manufacturers' sales of sports goods had a estimated value of 533 million British pounds (GBP).
charts.source: Office for National Statistics (UK)

charts.title: Turnover from retail sale of equipment and accessories for sport, camping, recreation and musical instruments in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2008 to 2021 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Sports and recreation equipment retail sales turnover in the UK 2008-2021
charts.description: This statistic shows the total annual turnover of the retail sale of equipment and accessories for sport, camping, recreation and musical instruments in the United Kingdom from 2008 to 2021. In 2021, turnover from the retail sale of such sports and leisure products amounted to nearly 7.1 billion British pounds.
charts.source: Office for National Statistics (UK)

charts.title: Consumer spending on equipment for sport, camping and open-air recreation in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2000 to 2023 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Expenditure on sport and camping equipment in the United Kingdom (UK) 2000-2023
charts.description: This statistic presents consumer spending on equipment for sport, camping and open-air recreation in the United Kingdom annually from 2000 to 2023. In 2023, over 10 billion British pounds was spent on sports and outdoor recreation equipment. Consumer spending on such recreational goods has nearly doubled since 2018.
charts.source: Office for National Statistics (UK)

charts.title: Number of specialized stores for the retail sales of sporting equipment in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2008 to 2022
charts.short: Number of retail stores for sporting equipment in the United Kingdom (UK) 2008-2022
charts.description: This statistic shows the number of retail enterprises selling sporting equipment in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2008 to 2022. By 2022, this total of sport equipment specialist stores had reached about 5,540, which is a decrease compared to the previous year, but still considerably higher than the counts recorded in previous years.
charts.source: Office for National Statistics (UK)

charts.title: Net revenues of the sporting goods retail sector in Germany from 2002 to 2022 (in billion euros)
charts.short: Revenue of sporting goods retail sector in Germany 2002-2022
charts.description: This statistic shows the development of sporting goods retail net revenues in Germany from 2002 to 2022. In 2022, net revenues of the sporting goods retail sector amounted to around 6.43 billion euros.
charts.source: Statistisches Bundesamt

charts.title: Sales value of the sporting goods sector in Spain between 2014 and 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Sporting goods sector revenue in Spain 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, the sporting goods sector in Spain generated a revenue of 8.9 billion euros, roughly 0.3 billion euros more than the previous year. Over the past years, the sales value of the sporting goods sector in Spain has increased steadily.
charts.source: AFYDAD; Interempresas Media; Sport Panel

charts.title: Turnover of sporting equipment retail stores in Italy from 2010 to 2021 (in million euros)
charts.short: Sporting equipment retail store sales in Italy 2010-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the turnover of the retail sale of sporting equipment in specialised stores in Italy increased by 922.2 million euros (+16.92 percent) since 2020. With 6.4 billion euros, the turnover thereby reached its highest value in the observed period.
charts.source: Eurostat

charts.title: Turnover from retail sale of sporting equipment in specialized stores in Norway from 2009 to 2023 (in million NOK)
charts.short: Sporting equipment retail sales in specialized stores in Norway 2009-2023
charts.description: Between 2009 and 2023, the annual turnover from the retail sale of sporting equipment in specialized stores increased considerably in Norway. In 2023, sports equipment retailers generated a sales turnover of approximately 16.9 billion Norwegian kroner.
charts.source: Statistics Norway

charts.title: Annual household consumption expenditure on equipment for sport, camping and open-air recreation in Sweden from 2008 to 2021 (in million SEK)
charts.short: Household consumption expenditure on sport and camping equipment in Sweden 2008-2021
charts.description: This statistic shows the annual household consumption expenditure on equipment for sport, camping and open-air recreation in Sweden from 2008 to 2021. Since 2012, expenses for these products have grown by more than five billion Swedish kronor. In 2021, household consumption spending on equipment for sport, camping and open-air recreation in Sweden reached over 15 billion Swedish kronor, a jump of more than two billion compared to the previous year.
charts.source: Statistics Sweden

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to United Kingdom (UK) from 2014 to 2023 (in 1,000 British pounds)
charts.short: United Kingdom: articles and equipment for sports import value 2014-2023
charts.description: The value generated from the import of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports in the United Kingdom declined to 1 billion British Pounds in 2023. Nevertheless, the last two years in this industry recorded a significant higher value than the preceding years.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports exported from United Kingdom (UK) from 2014 to 2023 (in 1,000 British pounds)
charts.short: United Kingdom: articles and equipment for sports export value 2014-2023
charts.description: The value generated from the export of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports in the United Kingdom declined to 357.9 million British Pounds in 2023. The value thereby reached its lowest value in recent years.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to Germany from 2016 to 2022 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: Germany: articles and equipment for sports import value 2016-2022
charts.description: This statistic presents the value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to Germany from 2016 to 2022. In 2022, imports of sports equipment and articles including swimming pools and paddling pools amounted to approximately 2.2 billion euros.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports exported from Germany from 2016 to 2022 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: Germany: articles and equipment for sports export value 2016-2022
charts.description: In 2022, Germany exported over 1.22 billion euros' worth of athletic equipment and articles to other countries around the world. This was a slight decrease compared to the previous year. Germany's import value for sporting goods and physical exercise equipment is consistently higher than its export value.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to France from 2015 to 2023 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: France: articles and equipment for sports import value 2015-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the value generated from the import of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports in France decreased by 284.5 million Euros (-17.37 percent) since 2022. Nevertheless, the last two years in this industry recorded a significant higher value than the preceding years.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports exported from France from 2014 to 2023 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: France: articles and equipment for sports export value 2014-2023
charts.description: This statistic presents the value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics, and other sports exported from France to other countries around the world from 2014 to 2023. In 2023, French exports of sports equipment and articles amounted to roughly 878 million euros, a decrease compared to last year's export value.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to the Netherlands from 2014 to 2022 (in 1,000s euros)
charts.short: Value of articles and equipment for sports imported in the Netherlands 2014-2022
charts.description: This statistic presents the value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to the Netherlands from 2014 to 2022. In 2022, imports of sports equipment and articles including swimming pools and paddling pools amounted to nearly 1.4 billion euros.
charts.source: International Trade Centre; Trade Map; UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports exported from the Netherlands from 2014 to 2022 (in 1,000s euros)
charts.short: Value of articles and equipment for sports exported from the Netherlands 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, sports equipment and article exports from the Netherlands to other countries around the world were valued at a total of approximately 1.2 billion euros, which is a considerable drop compared to the previous year.
charts.source: International Trade Centre; Trade Map; UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to Italy from 2014 to 2022 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: Italy: articles and equipment for sports import value 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, Italy imported roughly 797 million euros' worth of athletic equipment and articles from other countries. This was an increase compared to previous years. That same year, the Italian export value for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics, and other sports equipment stood at approximately 946 million euros.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports exported from Italy from 2014 to 2022 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: Italy: articles and equipment for sports export value 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, Italy exported approximately 946 million euros' worth of athletic equipment and articles to other countries around the world. This was a slight decrease compared to the previous year. Within the measured period, the value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics, and other sports exported from Italy was highest back in 2021.
charts.source: UN Comtrade

charts.title: Import value of sporting goods and equipment in Spain between 2015 and 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Sporting equipment import volume to Spain 2015-2022
charts.description: The total import value of sports equipment in Spain amounted to approximately 1.3 billion euros in 2022. Spanish imports of such goods fluctuated somewhat over the years, but followed a positive trend overall and grew considerably in 2021.
charts.source: INE (Spain); The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sport

charts.title: Export value of sporting goods and equipment in Spain between 2015 and 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Sporting equipment export value from Spain 2015-2022
charts.description: The total export value of sporting goods and equipment in Spain amounted to approximately 1.1 billion euros in 2022. Spanish exports of such goods increased in value each consecutive year since 2015.
charts.source: INE (Spain); The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sport

charts.title: Top online stores in the Sports & Outdoor segment in the UK in 2021, by e-commerce net sales (in million U.S. dollar)
charts.short: United Kingdom: Top 10 Sports & Outdoor online stores
charts.description: Sportsdirect.com is leading the Sports & Outdoor e-commerce market in the UK, with e-commerce net sales of US$716 million in 2021 generated in the UK, followed by nike.com with US$581 million. Third place is taken by argos.co.uk with a revenue of US$519 million. Amazon.co.uk is the fourth biggest Sports & Outdoor online store in the UK with net sales of US$427 million in 2021.
charts.source: ecommerceDB.com; Statista E-commerce revenue in million U.S. dollar

charts.title: Fitness equipment retailer websites in the United Kingdom (UK) with the highest online review score as of March 2023
charts.short: Highest reviewed fitness equipment retailer websites in the UK 2023
charts.description: As of March 2023, mirafit.co.uk and physicalcompany.co.uk each had a review score of 4.8 out of five, making them the best reviewed websites for buying fitness equipment in the United Kingdom (UK). decathlon.co.uk, which had a score of 4.4, accounted for the highest total number of reviews within this category.
charts.source: Salience Search Marketing Review score out of 5

charts.title: Leading fitness equipment retailers in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2023, by number of monthly brand searches
charts.short: UK fitness equipment retailers with the highest number of monthly brand searches 2023
charts.description: With a monthly search volume of over 800 thousand per month in the United Kingdom (UK), Decathlon was by far the leading fitness equipment retailer in terms of brand recall as of 2023. exercise.co.uk and kettlebells.co.uk each accounted for roughly 74 thousand brand searches a month.
charts.source: Salience Search Marketing Number of reviews

charts.title: Top online stores in the Sports & Outdoor segment in Germany in 2021, by e-commerce net sales (in million U.S. dollar)
charts.short: Germany: Top 10 Sports & Outdoor online stores
charts.description: Amazon.de is leading the Sports & Outdoor e-commerce market in Germany, with e-commerce net sales of US$464 million in 2021 generated in Germany, followed by otto.de with US$364 million. Third place is taken by zalando.de with a revenue of US$327 million. Nike.com is the fourth biggest Sports & Outdoor online store in Germany with net sales of US$263 million in 2021.

charts.title: Percentage of consumers that have a home fitness product within their households in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2021
charts.short: Share of consumers that own a home fitness product in the UK 2021
charts.description: This data on sports and fitness shows the results of the Statista Global Consumer Survey conducted in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2021. That year, approximately 74 percent of the survey respondents in the UK had at least one home fitness product in their home.
charts.note: United Kingdom; September 22 to 29, 2021; Over 1,000; 16-50 years; residential online population
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights

charts.title: Which of the following home fitness products does your household own?
charts.short: Share of UK consumers that own a home fitness product 2021, by product category
charts.description: In 2021, about 28 percent of consumers in the United Kingdom (UK) had either weights or dumbbells at home, making them some of the most commonly owned home fitness products in UK households. Many consumers in the UK also owned (yoga) mats. Approximately 74 percent of survey respondents owned at least one fitness product.
charts.note: United Kingdom; September 22 to 29, 2021; Over 1,000; 16-50 years; residential online population
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
categories: Fitness bands, expanders, ropes or straps

charts.title: Where did you buy sporting goods in the past 24 months?
charts.short: Share of consumers in the UK that bought sporting goods 2021, by store type
charts.description: When asked in 2021 where they had purchased sporting goods in the past two years, about 33 percent of surveyed consumers in the United Kingdom (UK) indicated that they bought from an online sporting goods store. Although online sporting goods stores were the most popular option, many shoppers also purchased from online marketplaces, online single brand stores, as well as offline single brand and outlet stores.
charts.note: United Kingdom; September 22 to 29, 2021; Over 1,000; 16-50 years; residential online respondents who purchased sporting goods in the past 24 months
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
categories: Single brand and outlet stores (e.g., Nike Store)
Sporting good stores (e.g., Dick's Sporting Goods)
Grocery stores, supermarkets & discounters (e.g., Wal Mart)

charts.title: Which types of sporting goods have you purchased in the past 24 months?
charts.short: Share of consumers in the UK that bought sporting goods 2021, by product type
charts.description: When asked in 2021 what sporting goods they had purchased in the past 24 months, 61 percent of consumers in the United Kingdom (UK) indicated that they bought sports footwear, making it the most commonly purchased kind of sports item in the country. About 27 percent of surveyed consumers in the UK had bought sports equipment and/or gear in the last two years.
charts.note: United Kingdom; September 22 to 29, 2021; Over 1,000; 16-50 years; residential online population
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
categories: I did not buy any sporting goods in the past 24 months

charts.title: What kind of sports equipment and gear have you purchased in the past 24 months?
charts.short: Leading sports gear bought by consumers in the UK in the past 24 months 2021
charts.description: When asked in 2021 what types of sports equipment and gear they had bought in the past 24 months, 32 percent of consumers in the United Kingdom (UK) indicated that they had acquired work-out equipment such as weights, dumbbells, or exercise mats. About 24 percent of the country's survey respondents had purchased balls.
charts.note: United Kingdom; September 22 to 29, 2021; Over 1,000; 16-50 years; residential online respondents who bought sports equipment and gear in the past 24 months
